FINDING_the_track1_route_is_not_in_versi.severity: highest finding of this stage, and it is not about archiving

deliberate_by_contrast.global_index/track1_runtime/: .gitignore:215 - append-only runtime output, megabytes, kept out of git on purpose
deliberate_by_contrast.track1_go_live_confirmation.json: .gitignore:211 - 'the file that ARMS the route, so it must never be something a checkout can create'

FINDING_the_track1_route_is_not_in_versi.how_the_two_were_told_apart: `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard` already excludes ignored files, so anything it lists is not ignored - merely never added. Confirmed per file with `git check-ignore`
FINDING_the_track1_route_is_not_in_versi.the_inconsistency: the confirmation record is deliberately ignored and documented; the swing paper override sitting beside it is neither ignored nor committed. Two decision records, two different treatments, one of them apparently unintended
consequences: the live order gate (track1_gates.py) has no version history at all

the Stage 5ZZZ-Q and 5ZZZ-T edits to safety files have no committed baseline to diff against - which is why Stage 5ZZZ-T could not use git to attribute a regression and had to neutralise the change at runtime instead
B1 evidence and the signed override exist only on this disk
FINDING_the_track1_route_is_not_in_versi.not_fixed_here: committing the route is a decision with real consequences - it is raised, measured and left to the operator, not done unasked

two_hazards_the_plan_caught_before_any_m.hazard: an active test imports a module on the move list
two_hazards_the_plan_caught_before_any_m.why_it_matters: this is exactly how tests/test_raits_vs_hold.py was broken by an earlier archive sweep and has stayed broken since
two_hazards_the_plan_caught_before_any_m.resolution: both reclassified to KEEP; the classifier now protects any module an active test imports

two_hazards_the_plan_caught_before_any_m.hazard: basename collision in a flat archive directory
two_hazards_the_plan_caught_before_any_m.why_it_matters: a flat move would have had one file silently overwrite the other - data loss, not just a broken link
two_hazards_the_plan_caught_before_any_m.resolution: the proposed archive path now preserves each file's relative path

part_4_archive_convention.rationale: the repo's existing convention, per docs/futures/ARCHIVE_LOG.md and the operator's Stage 5ZZZ-V decision. No new archive root is invented
part_4_archive_convention.log_requirement: each move needs an ARCHIVE_LOG.md entry: reason, replacement, and a verification that nothing imports it - the discipline whose absence left raits_vs_hold broken

is_a_second_apply_stage_safe.verdict: YES for the 379 candidates, with three conditions
conditions: re-verify each sha256 immediately before and after the move - the plan's hashes are from 2026-08-29 and scratch changes as work continues
write an ARCHIVE_LOG.md entry per file, with the 'nothing imports it' check
re-run pytest --collect-only afterwards and compare against 4,402 collected with 2 known pre-existing errors - any new error means something was still needed
is_a_second_apply_stage_safe.explicitly_not_safe_without_a_separate_d: committing the 40 uncommitted Track 1 source files. That is a version-control decision, not an archive one, and it should not ride along with a cleanup
